result.summary: Found 2 visual issues including an awkward card cutoff and a redundant discount badge.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is abruptly clipped by the viewport edge above the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom padding or margin to the scrollable container so cards are fully visible.

issues.description: The discount badge displays '-0%' which is redundant and looks like a data glitch.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge if the value is 0% or invalid.
